description: This PHP source file defines the 'Upgrade' class within the Opencart installation model. It provides methods for database schema modifications such as adding, retrieving, and removing records, tables, and fields during the upgrade process.

classes.name: Upgrade
classes.description: A class extending the Opencart system engine model to perform database upgrade and schema modification operations.

methods.name: addRecord
methods.description: Inserts a new record into a specified database table, escaping and formatting values based on their data types.

methods.name: getRecords
methods.description: Retrieves all records from a specified database table.

methods.name: hasTable
methods.description: Checks if a specific table exists in the database schema.

methods.name: hasField
methods.description: Checks if a specific field exists in a table.

methods.name: dropTable
methods.description: Drops a table from the database if it exists.

methods.name: dropField
methods.description: Removes a specific field from a table if it exists.
